title: Molten Aluminum-Induced Corrosion and Wear-Resistance Properties of ZrB<sub>2</sub>-Based Cermets Improved by Sintering-Temperature Manipulation.

recollection.structure: Likely optimized microstructure of ZrB2-based cermets
recollection.mechanism: Improved densification and grain boundary characteristics due to sintering temperature adjustment
recollection.results: Enhanced corrosion and wear resistance against molten aluminum, possibly with quantitative improvements in hardness and durability

score.note: The recollection captures only the title-level intervention and broadly suggests microstructural optimization, densification, and improved properties. It omits the SPS temperature range, 1500 °C optimum, HEA-binder pore-filling/binder-loss details, corrosion and wear mechanisms, and all quantitative results.
